questions.question: Walk me through your month-end close process at Ellwood Group, including the journal entries, accrual schedules, reconciliations, and roll-forward schedules you prepared.
Describe a balance sheet reconciliation you owned that had significant or unclear reconciling items. How did you research, resolve, and document the issue?

This role requires maintaining lease accounting schedules. Your Bloomberg experience included reviewing leases and contractual obligations in financial statements; how would you approach building and maintaining a lease schedule under US GAAP?
Tell me about your experience preparing monthly accruals. How did you determine the appropriate amount, prepare the entry, and reverse or true up the accrual in later periods?

At Ellwood Group, you maintained fixed-asset registers and calculated depreciation. What controls did you use to ensure capital expenditures, useful lives, disposals, and depreciation were recorded accurately?

Describe the monthly, quarterly, or annual financial reporting packages you prepared at George Washington University. What reports were included, who used them, and how did you ensure accuracy before distribution?

Give an example of a variance or flux analysis you performed between budget and actual results. What drove the variance, and how did you communicate the findings to management or operating departments?
How have you used Excel to prepare reconciliations, reporting packages, depreciation schedules, or account analyses? Which functions, tools, or controls do you rely on most?
Describe a time you worked with Accounts Payable or Purchasing to resolve an accounting issue, such as determining whether an invoice should be capitalized or expensed.
What steps do you take to ensure manual journal entries are complete, supported, appropriately approved, and compliant with US GAAP during a fast-paced close?
